entities.summary: Jafar Khan Zand, was the sixth shah (king) of the Zand dynasty of Iran from 1785 to 1789. He was the son of Sadegh Khan Zand, who was removed from the throne in Shiraz by Ali Murad Khan, who had previously taken Isfahan for himself.
